text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept away in the rush of daily life, 
many things have become distant memories, 
and just as many have faded from my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A horseshoe had somehow ended up in my 
possession. 
My memory of where I even got it was hazy. 
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, that name carved into the 
back 
remained stuck in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've seen it somewhere. 
But where could it have been...? 
Following the faint traces of memory, I 
searched my room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I flipped through the pages one by one. 
It was unmistakably my handwriting. Yet, I 
had no recollection of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I went out to the arcade shopping 
street 
with Azuma to look for books."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We found the book without trouble, and by 
chance, 
I learned about her hobby. 
Apparently, she writes about daily events 
in a diary."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Every time she reads it back, the 
memories of those days come alive. 
Azuma looked so happy talking about it, 
I found myself wanting to keep a diary 
too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Every time she reads it back, the 
memories of those days come alive. 
Azuma looked so happy talking about it, 
I found myself wanting to keep a diary 
too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I explored the trendy youth 
district with Azuma. 
Every single one of her reactions was so 
endearing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She says she avoids leaving physical 
traces of her form. 
Still, it felt like a waste to pass up 
photo sticker booths 
when she was so curious about them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There just happened to be masks in the 
booth, 
so we decided to take photos with her 
wearing one! 
It made for a great memento, and I'm 
really glad we did..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter which page I opened, 
it was filled with joyful memories. 
Why is it, then... that my chest aches so 
tightly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the writing, she seemed gentle and 
polite, 
possessing profound knowledge and 
boundless intellectual curiosity. 
Every place we visited, she seemed 
fascinated—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That gentle voice, those eyes filled with 
benevolence, 
and the expression she wore whenever she 
smiled at me— 
Every time I whispered her name, they 
flashed through my mind. Coming back to 
life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why hadn't I been able to recall 
such an important memory until now? 
With eager anticipation, I headed to the 
Shuntaisai operations headquarters.
choice_data_list:
She mentioned secluding herself in the 
annex... I wonder where that is.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...You have come to visit me. 
To visit Azuma, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? 
To think that you, too, were keeping a 
journal.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That explains everything.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad to see you again...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, what an unexpected blessing. 
To be able to meet you on this very day.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For I believed the next time we would 
cross paths 
would be during the Goshiki Shuntaisai— 
the festival honoring the bond between 
humans and Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—at Azuma-san's request— 
I told her about everything that had 
happened while we were apart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How the academy's students continued to 
grow, 
and how <chrname> was also living each day 
to the absolute fullest—
choice_data_list:
Supporting her has become even more 
rewarding than before.

Supporting her has become even more 
rewarding than before.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Yours is a radiant bond, as steadfast as 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hand in hand, walking forward step by 
step. 
Each and every stride 
weaves a brand new page of history, does 
it not?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are Umamusume harboring 
dreams. 
As long as there are people walking 
faithfully beside them. 
This sacred endeavor shall never cease.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As a shrine maiden, 
I wish nothing more than to watch over you 
all, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her warm words filled my chest with 
emotion. 
It's having someone watching over us like 
this 
that pushes us forward, empowering us to 
keep going.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for thanks. 
—For that is simply who I am.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—And so, 
I shall return to the annex once more.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You need not sorrow. 
Though we are apart, I shall ever be with 
you.
choice_data_list: Um... could I ask one favor of you?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...I am listening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Recalling the memories I shared with 
Azuma-san, 
and talking with her like this, a thought 
came to mind. 
And that was—
choice_data_list:
Someday, I'd like my journal added to your 
collection.

Someday, I'd like my journal added to your 
collection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing dreams with <chrname>, facing hurdles, and 
conquering them— 
those days, those memories. 
I want to hand them down as a chronicle 
portraying the bond between human and 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe. 
Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Very well, child of man. 
With utmost reverence, I accept your 
offer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Now, this time in truth, 
we must part for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Let us pray together one last time. 
May Umamusume and mankind... 
know everlasting fortune and bliss.
choice_data_list: Yes... May fortune be with us all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Lord <username>. 
Until the day we meet again.

title: Until the Day Our Paths Cross Again
